channel.title: Pajhwok Afghan News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: Trump’s ‘Board of Peace’ lacks legitimacy, not in region’s interest: Analysts
item.description: Some analysts say US President Donald Trump’s “Board of Peace” lacks legitimacy, could undermine the role of the United Nations and negatively affect the Palestinian issue, consists largely of US allies and that Pakistan joined it in violation of its laws and public sentiment.

item.title: Lawmaker among 15 killed in Colombia plane crash
item.description: At least 15 people, including a member of Congress, have been killed after a small plane crashed in a rural area of Colombia, media reports said on Thursday.

item.title: Turkish firm keen to invest in power generation, turbine repair
item.description: A Turkish firm has evinced keen interest in investing in electricity generation from water resources, turbine maintenance and repair, installation of modern high-capacity turbines and capacity building of technical staff in Afghanistan.

item.title: How home-based learning boosts children’s future success
item.description: At a time when the quality of education is increasingly linked to family involvement, the story of an 11-year-old girl in Kabul demonstrates how purposeful home-based and informal education, parental support and continuous encouragement can foster academic progress, moral development and a bright future.

item.title: Mother, 6 children killed in Nangarhar house roof collapse
item.description: A mother and her six children have been killed and the father injured after the roof of their house collapsed in eastern Nangarhar province.

item.title: Rain, snowfall forecast in 17 provinces
item.description: KABUL (Pajhwok): The Ministry of Energy and Water (MoEW) has alerted of the possibility of snowfall, rainfall, and flash floods over the next three days

item.title: SIGAR to end 17 years of operations on January 31
item.description: The Special Inspector General for Afghanistan Reconstruction (SIGAR) will cease operations on January 31, 2026, bringing an end to 17 years of activity.

item.title: Criminal Code based on Sharia, public to study it: Mujahid
item.description: The Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan (IEA) stated that the Criminal Code is based on Sharia and Hanafi jurisprudence, and no one should criticize Sharia; instead, people should study and understand it.

item.title: MoIC warns tourism firms over licence misuse, human trafficking
item.description: The Ministry of Information and Culture (MoIC) has warned that any tourism company found misusing its licence to engage in human trafficking will have its licence revoked and will be referred to judicial and legal authorities.

item.title: Japan, UNOPS launch $9.3m water security, climate resilience initiative in Kabul
item.description: KABUL (Pajhwok): Japan and the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) have launched a $9.3 million, three-year project to strengthen climate resilience and water
